heading: EXT. LIFEBOAT ON OPEN SEA - DAY

units.text: EXT. LIFEBOAT ON OPEN SEA - DAY
A steel-grey sea under a flat white sky.
The boat is a sealed orange cabin with a hatch left open.
Four survivors sit shoulder to shoulder on the benches.
RUTH, sixties, a retired purser, wears a stained uniform jacket and holds the emergency kit in her lap.
GUSTAVO, thirties, a deckhand, has a gash across one palm wrapped in a sock.
ANNELIESE, fifties, a passenger in a torn evening dress, rocks a little, eyes closed.
DWAYNE, twenties, the youngest, stares at the hatch, jaw clenched.
Nobody has spoken for a long time.
All right. Listen up, everybody. Rations. One cracker each at noon, one at dusk. Water twice a day. I'll mark the bottle.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Who made you captain?
units.name: GUSTAVO

units.text: I'm the one holding the kit.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Doesn't make it fair.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Say it louder, young man.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: I said nothing.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Please don't fight. It makes the boat feel smaller.
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: The boat is small.
units.name: GUSTAVO

units.text: I know it is.
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: Show me the hand.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: He holds it out.
She unwraps the sock, inspects the cut, wrinkles her nose.
Clean it with salt water. Then wrap it again.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Salt will sting.
units.name: GUSTAVO

units.text: It will.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: She hands him the bandage roll.
He takes it and does as told, hissing.
Three days. They said three days.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Who said?
units.name: GUSTAVO

units.text: The radio, before it went dead. Three days till a ship.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Then we have two more.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: If they're coming.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: They are coming. I dreamed it.
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: Oh, great. A dream.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Dwayne.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Sorry. Sorry.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Ruth opens the kit and counts crackers into four small piles.
She hands them out.
Gustavo eats his in one bite.
Anneliese holds hers in her palm without tasting.
Dwayne breaks his in half, saves one half in his pocket.
Smart.
units.name: GUSTAVO

units.text: Not smart. Scared.
units.name: DWAYNE

units.text: Same thing, out here.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: The sea slaps the hull.
The boat lifts and settles.
Does anyone know a song?
units.name: ANNELIESE

units.text: Nobody answers.
Then Gustavo, quietly, hums three notes.
Dwayne picks it up.
Ruth, to her own surprise, joins in.
They hum it, thin and cracked, over the empty water.
